about: Set out on an all-new adventure with Reimu, Marisa, Sanae, and more of your favorite Touhou characters! The land of Gensokyo once again plunges into darkness as a new mystery unfolds. What mysteries await in the Tower of Desire?
Based on the 'Touhou Project' world, Touhou Genso Wanderer Reloaded is a turn-based roguelike RPG where the dungeons and treasure change every time you play.
Collect wacky and powerful equipment and challenge dungeons alongside your NPC partner!
Remote Play requires PS Vita system and sufficiently robust Wi-Fi connection.
Licensed to and published by NIS America, Inc.
